merge into TRM_QUES_SCORE a using (select plo_num,sum(score) as score,EXAM_CODE from trm_ques_test where EXAM_CODE = #{examCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and IF_CORRECT=1 group by PLO_NUM,EXAM_CODE ) b on (a.EXAM_CODE = b.EXAM_CODE and a.PLO_NUM = b.PLO_NUM) when matched then update set a.USER_SCORE = b.score
update TRM_QUES_SCORE set COMP_STAT = 2 where COMP_STAT= 0 and EXAM_CODE = #{examCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: select a.PLO_NUM,BEG_DATE,END_DATE,USER_SCORE, case when COMP_STAT = 0 then '未参考' when COMP_STAT = 1 then '正常交卷' when COMP_STAT = 2 then '自动交卷' when COMP_STAT =3 then '免考' else concat('未定义-',COMP_STAT) end as COMP_STAT ,HANDLE_IP,c.BOOK_DATE,d.BEG_TIME,d.END_TIME from (select EXAM_CODE,PLO_NUM,BEG_DATE,END_DATE,USER_SCORE,COMP_STAT,HANDLE_IP from TRM_QUES_SCORE where EXAM_CODE = #{examCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) a left join (select INFO_CODE,BOOK_CODE,PLO_NUM,TIME_CODE,BOOK_DATE from TRM_BOOK_LIST where EXAM_CODE = #{examCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and LIST_STAT=1) b on (a.PLO_NUM = b.PLO_NUM) left join TRM_BOOK_INFO c on (a.EXAM_CODE = c.EXAM_CODE and b.INFO_CODE = c.INFO_CODE) left join TRM_BOOK_TIME d on (b.TIME_CODE = d.JOURNO)
mapper.delete: delete from TRM_QUES_SCORE where EXAM_CODE = #{examCode, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
